means: The danbooru count tag for 'there is one male figure in this image'. This is grammar, not description - it declares the population of the frame before anything else describes what is in it.
does: Fixes the head count at one male and anchors the whole tag stack: everything after it is read as belonging to that figure. Dropping it from a character shot is the fastest way to get two half-drawn people or a face that drifts androgynous. One trap in this library - MANAGER.json opens with '1man', which is not a danbooru count tag; the count that actually registers is 1boy, with age carried separately by 'mature male'.
reach_for_it: as the first tag of every shot containing exactly one male character - before hair, eyes, clothing or camera
used_in: the opening tag of characters/RASK.json and VIRO.json, every character beat in movies/derby-ep1.json, and the fixed subject sentence of all 976 capability-card panels
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
